integrity: Exact finite enumeration, acyclic matching, unimodular chain cancellation, and homotopical attaching-map argument are included; independently reproducible code and explicit matching certificate are attached.
result_summary: The ordered-word permutation complex generated by all ten transpositions on five letters is a two-sphere, a second two-sphere, and a three-sphere wedged together; it is the first mixed-positive-degree case for this generator family.
scientific_limitations: Only sizes two through five are classified; no infinite-family homotopy formula is asserted.
This is a regular Boolean cell complex of ordered subsequences, not an unordered simplicial complex.
No integral equivariant homology module is calculated.
Computational verification is exhaustive within the stated finite domain, but no independent audit or priority certification is claimed.
title: First mixed-dimensional transposition permutation complex on five letters
